# Actor

`schemas/records/actor.json`

Who acts (docs/design/m0/04 "Actors and tokens"). Operators are unrestricted (D31); supervisors act only under grants; system actors are adcd's own components. Tokens bound to an actor are secrets, stored hashed, never in this record.

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | [ActorID](common-defs.md#actorid) |  |
| `kind` | yes | one of `operator`, `supervisor`, `system` |  |
| `name` | yes | string (minLength `1`, maxLength `200`) | Display only. |
| `declared_agent` | yes | null or string (minLength `1`, maxLength `200`) | A self-declared label (e.g. a harness name); audit only, never enforcement. |
| `created_by` | yes | [ActorID](common-defs.md#actorid) | The actor that created this one; the first operator is created by the bootstrap secret, recorded as the system actor. |
| `revoked_at` | yes | null or [Time](common-defs.md#time) |  |

No other fields are allowed.
